Private fixture uses only valid fixed modes. New StandardMetricSource constructor acquires no registry/GC; its ownership transfers into retained context before initialize. Harness owns and explicitly closes context and unused synthetic registries. Early TWR-close of the transferred alias would be wrong. No universal constructor-allocation/OOME cleanup guarantee or real application-owner qualification inferred.
